evidence.reason: run_case captures mutated_files before the CLI, then calls cleanup() before any file-state assertion. In the unsafe-metadata case cleanup restores the drop-in to original_mode, so a controller chmod from 0666 to 0600 would be erased and never compared against mutated_files; the test can still pass. Capture repair_files() immediately after cli_activators returns and compare it with mutated_files before cleanup, and run cleanup in a finally block.
